Sora2.prompt: Cinematic slow pan shot in ancient Chinese anime style. Night scene inside a dilapidated wooden house, candlelight casting dancing shadows across faces. Close-up begins on a young Chinese woman, 18 years old, in pale green ruqun dress, leaning forward with earnest urgency, her almond eyes wide with desperate pleading, lips parted in rapid explanation, trying to convince someone of a dangerous truth. Camera slowly pans right to left across the dimly lit room, transitioning smoothly to reveal a pale sickly young man, 22 years old, sitting motionless in a worn wooden wheelchair, wearing a dark black traditional robe. His narrow phoenix eyes are narrowed in contemplation, thin pale lips slightly pressed together, expression shifting from cold suspicion to thoughtful consideration. A three-foot green sword is visible at the edge of frame, now noticeably lowered from its previous threatening position. Cold blue-grey lighting dominates with warm candlelight accents, shadows deepening the psychological tension. The pan movement is smooth and deliberate, ease-in-out speed profile, creating a visual connection between speaker and listener in this battle of words. Psychological drama atmosphere, strategic manipulation meets cautious evaluation.

SeeDance.prompt: 古风动漫风格，电影感慢速横摇镜头。夜晚破旧木屋内，烛火摇曳，光影在人物脸上跳动。镜头起始于辛月影近景，18岁少女身穿淡青色交领襦裙，身体微微前倾，杏眼中满是急切恳求，双唇微张急促解释，试图说服对方相信危险的真相。镜头缓缓从右向左横摇，穿过昏暗的空间，过渡到沈清起的近景，22岁病弱青年坐在破旧木制轮椅上，身穿玄色交领长袍，一动不动。他狭长的凤眼微微眯起陷入沉思，薄唇轻抿，表情从冰冷怀疑转为若有所思。三尺青锋剑在画面边缘可见，剑势明显放低。冷青色光线主导，烛火暖光点缀，阴影加深心理张力。横摇动作平稳缓慢，缓入缓出速度，在言语博弈中连接说话者与倾听者。心理剧氛围，言语试探与谨慎评估的交锋。
